intro.fr: Ty the Tasmanian Tiger 2 se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Ty the Tasmanian Tiger 2 can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub FyreDay/Archipelago-TyTheTasmanianTiger2, qui héberge l'APWorld de Ty the Tasmanian Tiger 2.
text.en: The GitHub repository FyreDay/Archipelago-TyTheTasmanianTiger2, home of the Ty the Tasmanian Tiger 2 APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v0.0.1 (préversion).
text.en: The first version, v0.0.1 (pre-release), is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v0.2.1, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (12 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v0.2.1 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (12 versions released).

text.fr: Ty the Tasmanian Tiger 2 figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Ty the Tasmanian Tiger 2 is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
